name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.205: Every worker row now reports only its own result - until now the green line handed
    the seeder's sentence to the download AND upload row, so two rows read identically. The scan also
    stopped printing the direction it never looked at, and the seeder row sums a both-direction cycle
    instead of letting the second leg overwrite the first. Settings page: the download tab reads in
    the order the cycle works - continue after daily limit, follow-up rounds, automatically
    synchronize. No setting changed value.
